# Rethinking Text-to-SQL: Dynamic Multi-turn SQL Interaction for Real-world Database Exploration

[All reading notes](../reading-notes.md) · [Catalog entry](../README.md#dysql-bench)

**Full paper read · 2026-11-09**

[Original source](https://aclanthology.org/2026.findings-acl.1654.pdf) · Findings of ACL 2026 proceedings, pp. 33047–33069

**Reading coverage:** All 23 pages: main sections 1–9; Appendices A–J with all repeated-run tables, qualitative failures, expert-review description, schema tree and complete displayed synthesis/verification/refinement/user prompts. Figure 3–4 visually inspected.

## Research question

SQL translation benchmarks often miss the dialogue management and database-state consequences of a user pursuing a multi-step goal involving updates, inserts or deletions.

## Method

DySQL-Bench synthesizes instructions and reference actions from relational data serialized as logic trees, then applies model validation, instruction backfilling, execution checks and reported expert review. A simulated user, evaluated agent and SQLite environment interact; task success compares final database-state hashes against reference execution.

## Evaluation

The paper reports 1,072 tasks across 13 databases, divides them by reference-action length, and tests multiple models with a 30-turn cap. Pass^k measures all k sampled runs succeeding, alongside per-domain accuracy, dialogue length, failed SQL calls and a marker-based fabricated-result diagnostic.

## What the results support

The reported GPT-4o score drops from 58.34% overall to 23.81% under Pass^5. Some models produce largely executable SQL yet fail the task, while others repeat or fabricate tool results. Few-shot examples yield modest gains in three tested domains.

## Limits and qualifications

The simulator dynamically responds toward an original fully parameterized instruction, so this is not unrestricted changing-goal evaluation. Final-state equality does not itself validate every conversational answer or intermediate action. Expert review is author-reported and cannot establish error-free data. Short/long counts total 1,062 rather than the stated 1,072. Performance uses one simulator family, and model-size or post-training explanations are observational.

## Relevance to reliable Text-to-SQL

A valuable adjacent testbed for stateful interaction, correction and repeated-run reliability, with a scoring boundary distinct from semantic equivalence of every SQL statement or user response.
